articles.title: Self-styled 'Godfather' gets 6 years in prison for $37 million Meta fraud scheme
articles.snippet: Adam Iza’s sentence runs concurrently with a 15-year term imposed last month for his role in an attempted bitcoin robbery.

articles.title: U.S. scraps proposed $10,000 reporting rule for for crypto sent to private wallets
articles.snippet: FinCEN withdrew two proposals that had hung over self-custody and crypto mixers for years without ever taking effect.

articles.title: Treasury crackdown exposes crypto's role in $2 million Hamas fundraising network
articles.snippet: The Treasury Department said the network raised more than $2 million through purported humanitarian charities, including hundreds of thousands of dollars sent in crypto.

articles.title: A Florida Woman Used Claude as a Diary. An Anthropic Employee Read It and Reported It to Police
articles.snippet: Investigators say a Bonita Springs woman's Claude "diary" tripped Anthropic's safety filters. A human review team sent it to police, and Anthropic's own terms allow exactly that.
